product.name: Glean Work AI Platform
product.description: An enterprise AI platform that connects workplace knowledge, business systems, permissions, and workflows to support search, content generation, analysis, and task automation.

product.name: Glean Assistant
product.description: An AI workplace assistant that uses company knowledge and connected business systems to answer questions, analyze information, create content, and help users complete work.

product.name: Glean Agents
product.description: A platform for building, deploying, orchestrating, and governing AI agents that perform multi-step work across enterprise systems.

product.name: Glean Enterprise Search
product.description: An AI-powered enterprise search product that indexes connected workplace content and returns permission-aware answers and results using contextual and hybrid search.

product.name: Glean Enterprise Context
product.description: A context layer that models personal, organizational, and system relationships to improve the relevance, accuracy, and security of enterprise AI responses.
